annotations.text:
Option A (top row) is the deliverable: it lifts the iOS app's own vocabulary — terracotta→burgundy brand gradient, 16px cards with the 0 2px 8px shadow, 32px status discs, SF system type (20/15/13/12), 4px gradient progress with a gold phase bar for post-processing.

Dark mode is the 'dark' tweak on each artboard.

B and C below are low-fi alternates in case a different direction is wanted.

Implementation notes: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS embedded in the Rust binary, no framework, no build step. Live data via the v2 WebSocket (snapshot + deltas), actions via api/v2/items/actions, picker from api/v2/catalog?url=. Paste anywhere focuses the add field. Installable as a PWA on phones.
